forest_burrow.role: shared family bed: 16x16 hollow sized for 12.8-15.4 wide adults (rim inner foot 7.8 out); leaf-litter pad with lining leaves and moss over the whole cell, exposed sides get a rim of loose dry grass pressed down in layers, nothing tied (crest 10.3 out, 5 back / 4 sides / 2.4 front high) with twigs and loose stems, built in the neighbouring block space

personal_leaf_nest.role: growing child's own bed, kept as a subadult and adult: oval hollow about 15.6x14.4, three build layers (scattered leaves and litter, low rough grass ring, bowl of loose grass pressed down in layers with twigs and loose stems)

bedding_bundle.role: finite harvested leaves and grass held at the mouth and placed before spreading: a small loose mouthful of dry grass and a leaf, not tied

kit_authored.author: standards/yukkuri-library/drafts/care-props/wild.py
kit_authored.note: Self-built nests of wild yukkuri share the hand-drawn wild_kit atlas with the forage pile and large_wild_nest (16x16 tiles and cut-out sprites, 1 texel per unit, no vanilla files or references). forest_burrow render units: 1 bedding, 2-5 side mids N/E/S/W, 6-9 corner arcs, 10-17 side ends (client/ShelterRenderer.sharedLeafLayers picks them so a connected nest gets one round-cornered rim); personal_leaf_nest units 1-3 unchanged.
